items.title: 与现在、过去、将来事实相反的虚拟条件句
items.brief: 三步定式：判时间、判主从、套公式

concept.summary: 判定标准：if 从句所述与事实相反或实现可能性极低时用虚拟语气。用虚拟后按三步操作——先定假设指向现在、过去还是将来，再分清哪一半是从句、哪一半是主句，最后按时间表套公式。公式的统一机制是：从句往过去退一步，主句加情态动词。

sections.h: 操作路径：三步定式
sections.p: 三步顺序不能颠倒。先定时间，是因为同一个 if 从句配不同的主句会表达完全不同的时间；再分主从，是因为两边形式不同，套错位置必错；最后套公式，只做机械对应。
bullets: 第一步 判时间：抓时间状语（now / yesterday / tomorrow）和语境，确定假设指向哪一段时间
第二步 判主从：if 引导的是从句，用过去范畴的形式；另一个分句是主句，用 would/could/might/should + 原形或完成式
第三步 套公式：按下面的三张表对号入座，主句与从句不能取同一种形式
be 动词在虚拟从句中一律用 were：If I were you, ...（不用 was）

sections.h: 表一 与现在事实相反
sections.p: 事实是现在不具备某条件，所以从句退到一般过去时，主句用 would + 原形。这一格覆盖 most 日常假设，判断信号是 now、today、at present 或明显的现在状态。
bullets: 从句谓语：did / were
主句谓语：would / could / might / should + do
例：If I had time, I would join you.（事实是现在没时间）
例：If she were here, she could answer the question.

sections.h: 表二 与过去事实相反
sections.p: 事实是过去已经发生且无法更改，所以从句退到过去完成时，主句用 would + have done。判断信号是 yesterday、last year、then 或上下文已锁定过去。
bullets: 从句谓语：had done
主句谓语：would / could / might / should + have done
例：If you had called, I would have picked you up.
例：If they had left earlier, they might have caught the train.

sections.h: 表三 与将来事实相反
sections.p: 将来的假设尚未发生，从句仍退到过去范畴，可用 did、were to do 或 should do，三者可能性依次降低；主句回到 would + 原形。
bullets: 从句谓语：did / were to do / should do
主句谓语：would / could / might / should + do
例：If it rained tomorrow, the match would be put off.
例：If he were to come tomorrow, I would tell him the truth.

examples.en: If I were you, I would apologize to her right now.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我现在就向她道歉。
examples.note: 与现在事实相反，从句用 were，主句用 would + 原形。

examples.en: If I am you, I would apologize to her right now.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我现在就向她道歉。
examples.note: 主句已用 would 锁定虚拟，从句必须退到过去范畴，改为 If I were you。

examples.en: If he had taken the medicine, he would have recovered sooner.
examples.zh: 如果他吃了药，他会好得更快。
examples.note: 与过去事实相反，从句 had done 配主句 would have done。

examples.en: If he took the medicine, he would have recovered sooner.
examples.zh: 如果他吃了药，他会好得更快。
examples.note: 主句 would have done 指向过去，从句却用了一般过去时，两边时间不一致，应改为 had taken。

examples.en: If it should rain tomorrow, we would cancel the trip.
examples.zh: 万一明天下雨，我们就取消行程。
examples.note: 与将来事实相反，从句用 should do，主句用 would + 原形。

examples.en: If it will rain tomorrow, we would cancel the trip.
examples.zh: 万一明天下雨，我们就取消行程。
examples.note: 虚拟条件从句不用 will，将来假设须退到 did、were to do 或 should do。

examples.en: If she were to leave now, she would catch the last bus.
examples.zh: 如果她现在动身，就能赶上末班车。
examples.note: were to do 表示将来假设，主句仍是 would + 原形。

pitfalls.wrong: If I would have known the truth, I would have told you.
pitfalls.right: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
pitfalls.why: would have done 只出现在主句；if 从句的过去相反形式固定为 had done，加上 would 就把情态动词挤进了从句。

pitfalls.wrong: If he studied harder last term, he would have passed the exam.
pitfalls.right: If he had studied harder last term, he would have passed the exam.
pitfalls.why: 主句用 would have done 已说明假设指向过去，从句必须同步退到过去完成时，last term 也确认了这一点。

pitfalls.wrong: If it will snow tomorrow, we would stay at home.
pitfalls.right: If it snowed tomorrow, we would stay at home.
pitfalls.why: will 属于真实条件句，表示说话人认为可能发生；主句用 would 时从句必须换成过去范畴的虚拟形式。

contrast.withTitle: 混合时间的虚拟条件句
contrast.diff: 本知识点要求主句与从句指向同一段时间，共用一张表；两半时间不一致时，各按自己的时间取形式。

concept.mnemonic: 从句退一步，主句加 would；现在 did，过去 had done，将来 were to do。

core: 三步：判时间（现在/过去/将来）→ 判主从 → 套公式
现在相反：if + did/were，主句 would + do
过去相反：if + had done，主句 would have done
将来相反：if + did/were to do/should do，主句 would + do
虚拟从句中 be 动词一律用 were，主句情态动词可选 would/could/might/should
review.trigger: 看到 if 分句所述与事实不符 → 先抓时间状语定时间 → 从句退一步、主句加情态动词

quickCheck.q: If I ___ (be) you, I would take the job. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: were，虚拟从句中 be 动词用 were。

quickCheck.q: “如果他昨天来了”用哪种形式？
quickCheck.a: If he had come yesterday，主句配 would have done。

quickCheck.q: 与将来事实相反的从句有哪三种写法？
quickCheck.a: did、were to do、should do。

drills.stem: If I ___ the answer, I would tell you at once.
drills.answer: knew
drills.explain: 主句 would tell 指向现在，从句须退到一般过去时表示与现在事实相反，故用 knew。
drills.trap: had known 是过去相反的形式，与主句 would tell 的现在指向不匹配。

drills.stem: If she ___ (be) here now, she would explain the rule to us.
drills.answer: were
accept: were
drills.hint: 句中有 now，判断为与现在事实相反；be 动词在虚拟从句中有固定形式。
drills.explain: now 说明假设指向现在，从句用一般过去时表虚拟，be 动词一律用 were 而不用 was。

drills.stem: If he had studied harder last term, he would pass the exam.
drills.answer: If he had studied harder last term, he would have passed the exam.
accept: If he had studied harder last term, he would have passed the exam.
drills.explain: 从句 had studied 与 last term 都锁定过去，主句必须同步用 would have done，否则主句变成与现在相反。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: If it rained tomorrow, the match would be put off.
drills.explain: 与将来事实相反的从句用一般过去时 rained，主句用 would + 原形，被动为 would be put off。

drills.stem: 如果我是你，我就接受这个提议。
drills.answer: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
drills.explain: 与现在事实相反：从句用 were，主句用 would + 动词原形，情态动词后不能再加过去式。

drills.stem: If the train ___ on time, we would have arrived before dark.
drills.answer: had arrived
drills.explain: 主句 would have arrived 指向过去，从句须用过去完成时 had arrived，两边时间才对得上。
drills.trap: arrived 只能表示与现在或将来相反，与主句的完成式冲突。

items.title: 混合时间的虚拟条件句
items.brief: 两半时间不同，各按自己的时间取形式

concept.summary: 判定标准：if 从句与主句所指时间不一致时，从句按自身时间退一步，主句按自身时间取情态动词形式，两边互不迁就。识别方法是给每个分句单独找时间状语：状语在哪一半，就只决定那一半的时间。

sections.h: 拆句标时间
sections.p: 处理混合时间的唯一办法是把句子拆成两半，分别标时间，再各自套公式。试图用一个公式同时满足两边，必然在某一半上出错。
bullets: 从句指过去 + 主句指现在：if + had done → would + do，主句常带 now、today
从句指现在 + 主句指过去：if + did/were → would have done，主句常带 yesterday、last week
从句指过去 + 主句指将来：if + had done → would + do，主句常带 tomorrow、next year

sections.h: 时间状语落在哪一半
sections.p: now、at present、today 出现在主句，说明主句指现在；yesterday、last night、then 出现在主句，说明主句指过去。状语只约束它所在的分句，不能反向推到另一半。
bullets: If you had taken my advice then, you would be a manager now.（从句过去，主句现在）
If I were not so busy today, I would have gone with you yesterday.（从句现在，主句过去）
If we had booked the tickets last week, we would be flying to Paris tomorrow.（从句过去，主句将来）

sections.h: 为什么不能共用一套形式
sections.p: 虚拟语气靠退一步表达时间：现在退到过去式，过去退到过去完成。主句的 would do 与 would have done 分别锁定现在与过去，用错就等于改写了句子的时间。
bullets: would do 表示与现在或将来的事实相反，动作尚未结束
would have done 表示与过去的事实相反，动作已经结束
判断依据是时间状语和语义，不是前一个分句用了什么形式

examples.en: If you had followed the doctor's advice, you would feel much better now.
examples.zh: 如果你当时听了医生的话，你现在会好受得多。
examples.note: 从句 had done 指过去，主句 would feel 配 now 指现在。

examples.en: If you had followed the doctor's advice, you would have felt much better now.
examples.zh: 如果你当时听了医生的话，你现在会好受得多。
examples.note: now 要求主句指现在，用 would have felt 会把主句也推到过去，与 now 冲突。

examples.en: If she were more careful, she would not have made that mistake yesterday.
examples.zh: 如果她更细心一些，昨天就不会犯那个错误。
examples.note: 从句 were 指现在的一贯性格，主句 would not have made 配 yesterday 指过去。

examples.en: If she had been more careful, she would not make that mistake yesterday.
examples.zh: 如果她更细心一些，昨天就不会犯那个错误。
examples.note: 主句带 yesterday 却用 would make，时间错位，应改为 would not have made。

examples.en: If we had left earlier, we would be at the airport by now.
examples.zh: 如果我们早点出发，现在就到机场了。
examples.note: 过去的条件造成现在的结果，从句 had left，主句 would be。

examples.en: If he had taken the job, he would be living in Shanghai today.
examples.zh: 如果他当时接受了那份工作，他今天就会住在上海。
examples.note: 从句指过去的选择，主句用 would be doing 指现在持续的状态。

examples.en: If I knew his address, I would have written to him last week.
examples.zh: 如果我知道他的地址，上周就给他写信了。
examples.note: 从句 knew 指现在不知道，主句 would have written 指上周，属从句现在、主句过去。

pitfalls.wrong: If you had set the alarm, you would not be late for the interview yesterday.
pitfalls.right: If you had set the alarm, you would not have been late for the interview yesterday.
pitfalls.why: yesterday 在主句，主句必须用 would have done；would be 只能指现在或将来。

pitfalls.wrong: If he were a careful driver, he would not have crashed the car last night.
pitfalls.right: If he had been a careful driver, he would not have crashed the car last night.
pitfalls.why: 这一句两边都指过去，从句要跟着主句退到 had been；只有主句指现在时才保留 were。

pitfalls.wrong: If she had studied medicine, she is a doctor now.
pitfalls.right: If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor now.
pitfalls.why: 条件句的主句必须用情态动词 would，不能用陈述语气的 is。

contrast.withTitle: 与现在、过去、将来事实相反的虚拟条件句
contrast.diff: 单一时间句两半共用一张时间表；混合时间句要先拆句，再让每一半各自对号入座。

concept.mnemonic: 先拆两半再标时间，状语管自己那一半；过去 had done，现在 would do。

core: 混合时间 = 从句与主句指向不同时间，各取各的形式
从句过去 + 主句现在：had done → would do（now 在主句）
从句现在 + 主句过去：did/were → would have done（yesterday 在主句）
时间状语只约束它所在的分句
would do 锁定现在/将来，would have done 锁定过去
review.trigger: 看到 if 句里 now 与 yesterday 同时出现 → 立刻拆句，分别定时间

quickCheck.q: If you had listened, you ___ (not be) in trouble now. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: would not be，主句指现在。

quickCheck.q: If I were you, I ___ (accept) the offer last week. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: would have accepted，主句指过去。

quickCheck.q: 混合时间句能不能两半都用 had done？
quickCheck.a: 不能，主句指现在时必须用 would do。

drills.stem: If you had taken the job last year, you ___ in Shanghai now.
drills.answer: would live
drills.explain: 从句 had taken 配 last year 指过去，主句带 now 指现在，须用 would + 原形。
drills.trap: would have lived 会把主句也推到过去，与 now 直接冲突。

drills.stem: If she ___ (not miss) the flight yesterday, she would be in London now.
drills.answer: had not missed
accept: had not missed
hadn't missed
drills.hint: yesterday 在从句，now 在主句，两边时间不同。
drills.explain: 从句由 yesterday 锁定过去，用过去完成时 had not missed；主句由 now 锁定现在，保持 would be。

drills.stem: If she took the medicine yesterday, she would feel better now.
drills.answer: If she had taken the medicine yesterday, she would feel better now.
accept: If she had taken the medicine yesterday, she would feel better now.
drills.explain: yesterday 说明从句指过去，须用过去完成时 had taken；主句 would feel 配 now 是正确的，不需改动。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: If you had started earlier, you would be there now.
drills.explain: 从句 had started 指过去，主句 would be 配 now 指现在，两半各取自己的形式。

drills.stem: 如果你去年听了我的建议，现在就不会这么被动。
drills.answer: If you had taken my advice last year, you would not be in such a difficult position now.
drills.explain: last year 使从句用 had taken，now 使主句用 would not be；主句若用完成式就与 now 矛盾。

drills.stem: If he ___ a better memory, he would not have forgotten the appointment yesterday.
drills.answer: had
drills.explain: 从句说的是他现在记性不好这一事实，用一般过去时 had；主句由 yesterday 锁定过去，用 would not have forgotten。
drills.trap: had had 会把从句也推到过去，与主句里 yesterday 只约束主句这一结构不符。

items.title: 省略 if 的倒装虚拟
items.brief: had/were/should 提前，删掉 if，其余不动

concept.summary: 判定标准：if 从句的谓语含 had、were、should 三者之一时，可以省略 if，把这三个词提到主语前构成部分倒装；不含这三个词的虚拟从句不能倒装。倒装只改语序，不改公式，主句形式完全不变。

sections.h: 三个可以提前的词
sections.p: 能提前的只有助动词 had、be 动词 were、情态动词 should，因为只有它们能充当倒装的触发成分。提前之后 if 必须删除，if 与倒装不能同时出现。
bullets: Had + 主语 + done：Had I known, I would have told you.
Were + 主语 + 表语/doing/to do：Were she here, she would help us.
Should + 主语 + do：Should it rain, the match would be put off.
从句谓语是实义动词过去式时没有可提前的成分：× Did I know, ... 只能说 If I knew, ...

sections.h: 否定倒装：not 留在主语之后
sections.p: 倒装只移动 had/were/should，not 不从它们后面跟着走，位置保持在主语之后。写成 Had not I 是语序错误。
bullets: Had it not been for your help, I would have failed.
Were it not for the rain, we would be on the beach now.
Should he not agree, we would have to change the plan.
× Had not it been for your help

sections.h: 先还原，再套公式
sections.p: 识别倒装句的顺序是反向的：先把 had/were/should 放回主语后、补上 if，得到普通虚拟条件句，再走判时间、判主从、套公式三步。这样就不会误判时态。
bullets: Had I known → If I had known（过去相反）→ 主句 would have done
Were she here → If she were here（现在相反）→ 主句 would do
Should it rain → If it should rain（将来相反）→ 主句 would do

examples.en: Had I known the truth, I would have spoken out.
examples.zh: 如果我当时知道真相，我就会说出来。
examples.note: Had 提前代替 If I had known，主句用 would have done 与过去时间一致。

examples.en: Had I known the truth, I would speak out.
examples.zh: 如果我当时知道真相，我就会说出来。
examples.note: 从句已用 had known 锁定过去，主句须用 would have spoken，不能用 would speak。

examples.en: Were she here, she would take charge of the meeting.
examples.zh: 如果她在这儿，她会主持会议。
examples.note: Were 提前代替 If she were here，主句用 would + 原形。

examples.en: Were she here, she will take charge of the meeting.
examples.zh: 如果她在这儿，她会主持会议。
examples.note: 虚拟主句只能用 would/could/might/should，不能用表示真实将来的 will。

examples.en: Should it rain tomorrow, the ceremony would be moved indoors.
examples.zh: 万一明天下雨，仪式就改到室内举行。
examples.note: Should 提前表示将来假设，主句用 would be moved。

examples.en: Had not I been there, the accident would have been worse.
examples.zh: 要不是我在场，事故会更严重。
examples.note: 倒装时 not 必须留在主语之后，应改为 Had I not been there。

examples.en: Were it not for his support, the project would have collapsed.
examples.zh: 要不是他的支持，这个项目早就垮了。
examples.note: Were it not for 是固定倒装形式，等于 If it had not been for。

pitfalls.wrong: Had I not helped him, he would fail the exam.
pitfalls.right: Had I not helped him, he would have failed the exam.
pitfalls.why: 倒装不改时间，从句 had helped 指过去，主句必须用 would have failed。

pitfalls.wrong: Did I know the answer, I would tell you.
pitfalls.right: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
pitfalls.why: did 型虚拟没有助动词可以提前，只有 had、were、should 能触发倒装。

pitfalls.wrong: Had not she apologized, he would still be angry.
pitfalls.right: Had she not apologized, he would still be angry.
pitfalls.why: 倒装只把 had 移到主语前，not 仍留在主语之后，构成 Had she not done。

contrast.withTitle: 含蓄条件句与 otherwise/but for
contrast.diff: 倒装虚拟仍有完整的 if 从句，只是删掉 if 并移动助动词；含蓄条件句把条件压缩成介词短语或副词，没有从句可以倒装。

concept.mnemonic: had/were/should 提前，if 退场；not 不跟着走；还原之后再套表。

core: 只有 had、were、should 可以提前，其余虚拟从句不能倒装
倒装后 if 必须删除，两者不能并存
not 留在主语之后：Had she not apologized
还原成 if 从句后再判时间，主句形式完全不变
高频固定式：Had it not been for / Were it not for
review.trigger: 句首看到 Had/Were/Should + 主语 → 先补 if 还原 → 再判时间套公式

quickCheck.q: If he had left earlier 改成倒装怎么说？
quickCheck.a: Had he left earlier。

quickCheck.q: Were it not for the rain 相当于什么？
quickCheck.a: If it were not for the rain。

quickCheck.q: Did I know him 这种倒装成立吗？
quickCheck.a: 不成立，did 型虚拟没有可提前的助动词。

drills.stem: ___ I known about the traffic, I would have left much earlier.
drills.answer: Had
drills.explain: 从句本是 If I had known，省略 if 后把 had 提到主语前，构成 Had I known。
drills.trap: If 与 I known 搭配缺少 had，本身就不成立；Have 不能构成过去完成倒装。

drills.stem: ___ it not been for your timely help, we would have lost the contract.
drills.answer: Had
accept: Had
drills.hint: 这是 If it had not been for 的倒装形式。
drills.explain: 省略 if 后把 had 提到句首，not 留在主语 it 之后，构成 Had it not been for。

drills.stem: Had she worked harder, she would pass the entrance exam last year.
drills.answer: Had she worked harder, she would have passed the entrance exam last year.
accept: Had she worked harder, she would have passed the entrance exam last year.
drills.explain: 倒装句的时间由 had worked 与 last year 锁定在过去，主句须用 would have done。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Had I known about the delay, I would have left later.
drills.explain: Had I known 是 If I had known 的倒装，主句用 would have left 与过去时间一致。

drills.stem: 要是她当时在场，她就会阻止这场争吵。
drills.answer: Had she been present, she would have stopped the quarrel.
forbid: If she had been present, she would stop
drills.explain: Were 型倒装在这里换成 had been：Had she been present 等于 If she had been present，主句配 would have stopped。

drills.stem: ___ he not been so stubborn, the two sides would have reached an agreement.
drills.answer: Had
drills.explain: 从句谓语是 had been，倒装时 had 提前、not 留在主语之后，构成 Had he not been。
drills.trap: Were 只能用于 be 动词作谓语的从句，此处谓语是 had been，不能换成 Were。

items.title: wish 后的虚拟语气
items.brief: wish 后按时间三选一，从句绝不用现在时

concept.summary: 判定标准：wish 后的宾语从句一律用虚拟，因为所愿望的内容与事实相反或几乎不可能。形式由从句内容的时间决定：与现在相反用 did/were，与过去相反用 had done，对将来的愿望用 would/could do。从句谓语不能出现一般现在时。

sections.h: 三张形式表
sections.p: wish 从句没有主句，只有从句本身要变形，所以判断更简单：只看愿望指向哪段时间。
bullets: 对现在（事实相反）：wish + 主语 + did/were。I wish I knew the answer.
对过去（无法挽回的遗憾）：wish + 主语 + had done。I wish I had studied harder.
对将来（期待改变，可能性低）：wish + 主语 + would/could do。I wish it would stop raining.
be 动词一律用 were：I wish I were taller.

sections.h: wish 与 hope 的分界
sections.p: hope 接陈述语气，因为所希望的事有实现的可能；wish 接虚拟，因为说话人已知与事实不符。判断依据是说话人对可能性的态度，不是后面的时态词。
bullets: I hope she passes the exam.（有可能）
I wish she passed the exam.（事实是没通过或不会通过）
I hope you had a good trip.（陈述过去的经历）
× I wish you will pass the exam.

sections.h: 同型结构：would rather 与 If only
sections.p: would rather 后接从句、If only 引导的感叹句与 wish 共用同一套时间形式，可以合并记忆，区别只在语气强度。
bullets: I would rather you came tomorrow.（对将来，用过去式）
I would rather you had told me earlier.（对过去，用过去完成）
If only I had listened to you!（强烈的遗憾）
If only he were here now!

examples.en: I wish I were a little taller.
examples.zh: 我真希望自己再高一点。
examples.note: 与现在事实相反，be 动词用 were。

examples.en: I wish I am a little taller.
examples.zh: 我真希望自己再高一点。
examples.note: wish 从句不能用一般现在时，与现在相反须用 were。

examples.en: I wish I had taken your advice last year.
examples.zh: 我真希望去年听了你的建议。
examples.note: 对过去的遗憾，用 had done。

examples.en: I wish I took your advice last year.
examples.zh: 我真希望去年听了你的建议。
examples.note: last year 指向过去，须用过去完成时 had taken，一般过去时只能表示与现在相反。

examples.en: I wish it would stop raining before noon.
examples.zh: 我希望中午前雨能停。
examples.note: 对将来的愿望，用 would + 原形。

examples.en: I hope you will pass the driving test.
examples.zh: 我希望你能通过驾照考试。
examples.note: hope 接陈述语气，因为有实现的可能，用 will 正常。

examples.en: I wish he were more patient with his students.
examples.zh: 我真希望他对学生更有耐心。
examples.note: 对现在性格的愿望，用 were 表与事实相反。

pitfalls.wrong: I wish I can fly like a bird.
pitfalls.right: I wish I could fly like a bird.
pitfalls.why: wish 后不能用现在时情态动词，对现在能力的愿望须退到 could。

pitfalls.wrong: I wish I have studied harder at school.
pitfalls.right: I wish I had studied harder at school.
pitfalls.why: 对过去的遗憾要用过去完成时 had done，现在完成时仍指向现在，与 wish 的虚拟要求不符。

pitfalls.wrong: I wish he is here now.
pitfalls.right: I wish he were here now.
pitfalls.why: wish 从句表示与现在事实相反，be 动词一律用 were，不能用 is。

contrast.withTitle: as if / as though 的虚拟
contrast.diff: wish 后的从句必须虚拟；as if 后的从句可虚拟也可陈述，取决于说话人是否认为所述可能是事实。

concept.mnemonic: 现在 were，过去 had done，将来 would do；wish 后面没有现在时。

core: wish 从句一律虚拟，不出现一般现在时
对现在：did/were；对过去：had done；对将来：would/could do
be 动词在 wish 从句中一律 were
hope 接陈述语气，wish 接虚拟，分界在可能性
would rather + 从句、If only 与 wish 同型
review.trigger: 看到 wish + that 从句 → 先问愿望指向哪段时间 → 三选一，不选现在时

quickCheck.q: I wish I ___ (know) the answer. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: knew，与现在事实相反。

quickCheck.q: “真希望昨天没迟到”怎么写？
quickCheck.a: I wish I had not been late yesterday。

quickCheck.q: wish 后能不能用 will？
quickCheck.a: 不能，对将来用 would/could do。

drills.stem: I wish I ___ how to swim; the pool looks so inviting.
drills.answer: knew
drills.explain: wish 后表示与现在事实相反，从句用一般过去时 knew；后半句的现在语境也印证了这一点。
drills.trap: had known 表示对过去的遗憾，与“现在不会游泳”这一事实不符。

drills.stem: I wish I ___ (not waste) so much time playing games last term.
drills.answer: had not wasted
accept: had not wasted
hadn't wasted
drills.hint: last term 指向过去，wish 后要用过去完成时。
drills.explain: 对过去无法改变的事表示遗憾，wish 从句用 had done，否定式为 had not done。

drills.stem: I wish I have accepted the offer from that company.
drills.answer: I wish I had accepted the offer from that company.
accept: I wish I had accepted the offer from that company.
drills.explain: 对已过去的机会表示遗憾，wish 从句须用过去完成时 had accepted，现在完成时不能表达虚拟的过去。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I wish I had taken your advice last year.
drills.explain: wish 后接过去完成时 had taken，表示对去年未听建议的遗憾。

drills.stem: 我真希望他现在就在我身边。
drills.answer: I wish he were by my side now.
drills.explain: 与现在事实相反，wish 从句的 be 动词用 were，不能用 is 或 was。

drills.stem: I wish it ___ raining so that we could go for a walk.
drills.answer: would stop
drills.explain: could go 表明愿望指向将来，wish 后对将来的期待用 would + 原形，表示希望情况发生改变。
drills.trap: stopped 只能表示与现在事实相反，无法表达“希望雨停下来”这一将来指向。

items.title: 建议命令要求类动词后的 should 省略
items.brief: 四组触发词 + suggest 表暗示的例外

concept.summary: 判定标准：坚持、命令、建议、要求四类动词后接 that 宾语从句，且从句内容尚未实现时，谓语用 (should) + 动词原形，should 可省略。判断只看从句是不是一个“待实现的主张”，与主句时态无关——主句用过去式，从句仍用原形。

sections.h: 触发词四组，用法只有两类
sections.p: 触发词按语义分四组记忆，它们的形式完全相同，都是 that + 主语 + (should) do；但按用法归并只有两类：主张义触发虚拟，事实义不触发虚拟。识别时先看主句动词属于哪一组，再确认从句内容是主张还是既成事实。
bullets: 一坚持：insist（坚持要求）
二命令：order, command
三建议：suggest, advise, propose, recommend
四要求：demand, require, request, ask, desire
派生名词与形容词同样触发：his suggestion that... / It is required that...

sections.h: 两类情形：主张用原形，事实用陈述
sections.p: 触发词只有两类用法需要区分。第一类是“主张、要求、建议”义，从句是尚未实现的事，用 (should) do；第二类是 suggest 表“暗示、表明”、insist 表“坚持说”时，从句内容是既成事实，用陈述语气并随时态呼应。
bullets: The doctor suggested that he (should) give up smoking.（建议，用原形）
Her pale face suggested that she was ill.（暗示，用陈述语气 was）
He insisted that he had not stolen the money.（坚持说，陈述事实）
He insisted that we (should) leave at once.（坚持要求，用原形）

sections.h: 省略 should 后的三个形式细节
sections.p: should 省略后，从句谓语只剩动词原形，没有时态和人称变化，这是失分最集中的地方。否定、被动都直接加在原形结构上。
bullets: 第三人称单数也不加 s：He demanded that she leave immediately.
否定在动词前加 not：He demanded that she not leave.
被动用 (should) be done：They requested that the meeting (should) be postponed.
主句改用过去式，从句仍是原形：She suggested that he wait outside.

examples.en: The manager insisted that the report be submitted by Friday.
examples.zh: 经理坚持要求周五前提交报告。
examples.note: insist 表坚持要求，从句用原形 be，省略了 should。

examples.en: The manager insisted that the report was submitted by Friday.
examples.zh: 经理坚持说报告已在周五前提交。
examples.note: insist 表“坚持说”，从句是既成事实，用陈述语气 was；语义与上一句不同。

examples.en: She suggested that he wait outside for a moment.
examples.zh: 她建议他在外面等一会儿。
examples.note: suggest 表建议，主句用过去式，从句仍用原形 wait。

examples.en: She suggested that he waited outside for a moment.
examples.zh: 她建议他在外面等一会儿。
examples.note: 建议义从句不用时态呼应的 waited，应回到原形 wait。

examples.en: Her silence suggested that she disagreed with the plan.
examples.zh: 她的沉默表明她不同意这个计划。
examples.note: suggest 表“暗示、表明”，从句用陈述语气 disagreed。

examples.en: Her silence suggested that she disagree with the plan.
examples.zh: 她的沉默表明她不同意这个计划。
examples.note: suggest 表暗示时不触发虚拟，用原形 disagree 会把语义改成“建议”。

examples.en: The committee recommended that the plan be delayed until next spring.
examples.zh: 委员会建议把计划推迟到明年春天。
examples.note: recommend 表建议，从句用被动原形 be delayed。

examples.en: They required that every applicant submit two references.
examples.zh: 他们要求每位申请人提交两封推荐信。
examples.note: require 表要求，从句主语第三人称单数，动词仍用原形 submit。

pitfalls.wrong: He suggested that she goes to see a doctor.
pitfalls.right: He suggested that she go to see a doctor.
pitfalls.why: 建议义从句用 (should) do，省略 should 后谓语为原形，不受第三人称单数影响。

pitfalls.wrong: He suggested us to postpone the meeting.
pitfalls.right: He suggested that we (should) postpone the meeting.
pitfalls.why: suggest 不能接“宾语 + 不定式”，表建议时只能接 that 从句或动名词。

pitfalls.wrong: The look on his face suggested that he be angry.
pitfalls.right: The look on his face suggested that he was angry.
pitfalls.why: 此处 suggest 意为“表明”，从句是既成事实，用陈述语气，不触发虚拟。

contrast.withTitle: It is important that 句型中的虚拟
contrast.diff: 本知识点的触发点是主句动词，识别位置在 that 从句之前；形容词句型由 It is + adj + that 触发，识别位置在句首。

concept.mnemonic: 一坚持二命令三建议四要求，that 从句用原形；suggest 表暗示，回到陈述语气。

core: 四组触发词：insist / order,command / suggest,advise,propose,recommend / demand,require,request,ask,desire
从句谓语 (should) do，should 省略后只剩原形，不加 s、不变时态
否定 not + 原形，被动 (should) be done
suggest 表暗示、insist 表坚持说时用陈述语气
主句时态不影响从句形式：suggested that he wait
review.trigger: 看到四个触发动词 + that 从句 → 先判是“主张”还是“事实” → 主张用原形，事实用陈述

quickCheck.q: He demanded that she ___ (leave) at once. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: leave，省略 should 后用原形。

quickCheck.q: Her smile suggested that she ___ (be) satisfied. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: was，此处 suggest 表暗示。

quickCheck.q: suggest 能说 suggest sb. to do 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，要用 suggest that sb. (should) do 或 suggest doing。

drills.stem: The doctor suggested that he ___ smoking immediately.
drills.answer: give up
drills.explain: suggest 表建议，从句用 (should) + 原形，省略 should 后为 give up，不随主句过去式变化。
drills.trap: gave up 套用了宾语从句的时态呼应规则，但建议义从句固定用原形。

drills.stem: Her pale face suggested that she ___ (be) seriously ill.
drills.answer: was
accept: was
drills.hint: 先判断 suggest 在这里是什么意思。
drills.explain: 此处 suggest 意为“表明、暗示”，从句陈述既成事实，用陈述语气 was，不触发虚拟。

drills.stem: He insisted that the meeting is postponed until next week.
drills.answer: He insisted that the meeting be postponed until next week.
accept: He insisted that the meeting be postponed until next week.
He insisted that the meeting should be postponed until next week.
drills.explain: insist 表坚持要求，从句用 (should) be done，省略 should 后为 be postponed，不能用陈述语气的 is。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The manager demanded that all staff arrive before eight.
drills.explain: demand 表要求，从句谓语用原形 arrive，主句虽是过去式也不改成 arrived。

drills.stem: 他建议我们推迟会议。
drills.answer: He suggested that we (should) put off the meeting.
drills.explain: suggest 表建议接 that 从句，从句用 (should) + 原形；suggest 不能接“宾语 + 不定式”。

drills.stem: The committee recommended that the plan ___ until next spring.
drills.answer: be delayed
drills.explain: recommend 表建议，从句用 (should) be done，省略 should 后为 be delayed。
drills.trap: is delayed 是陈述语气，忽略了建议义从句必须用原形这一要求。

drills.stem: She suggested that he waits outside for a moment.
drills.answer: She suggested that he wait outside for a moment.
accept: She suggested that he wait outside for a moment.
She suggested that he should wait outside for a moment.
drills.explain: suggest 表建议，省略 should 后从句谓语为原形 wait，第三人称单数也不加 s。

items.title: It is important that 句型中的虚拟
items.brief: It is + 评价形容词 + that，从句用原形

concept.summary: 判定标准：It is + 表必要、重要、奇怪、可惜的形容词 + that 从句时，从句谓语用 (should) + 动词原形。判据是把从句还原成“应该发生的事”，能补出 should 而语义不变即用虚拟；若从句陈述已发生的事实，则用陈述语气。

sections.h: 形容词清单与分组
sections.p: 这类形容词的共同点是对话内容作主观评价，从句所述是尚未实现或令人意外的事。按语义分四组记忆，比逐个背更稳。
bullets: 必要类：necessary, essential, vital, imperative, important
建议类：advisable, desirable, preferable, better
意外类：strange, surprising, odd, incredible, natural（竟然是）
遗憾类：a pity, a shame, regrettable

sections.h: should 的保留与省略
sections.p: should 可省，省略后从句谓语用原形，不随主句时态与从句主语变化。保留 should 时多带“竟然”意味，常见于 strange、a pity 一类评价。
bullets: It is necessary that every member (should) inform us in advance.
It is strange that she (should) refuse such an offer.
It is important that the report (should) be submitted by Friday.
从句主语是第三人称单数也不加 s：It is vital that he stay calm.

sections.h: 与 It is ... that 强调句的分界
sections.p: 用删减法一步区分：去掉 It is 和 that 后，剩下的是完整句子就是强调句；剩下的是“形容词 + 主张”、无法独立成句就是虚拟句型。
bullets: It is important that he (should) attend.（去掉后 he attend 不成立 → 虚拟）
It is in this room that he studies.（去掉后 he studies in this room 成立 → 强调句）
It is a fact that the earth moves around the sun.（陈述事实，不用虚拟）

examples.en: It is necessary that he be told the truth.
examples.zh: 有必要让他知道真相。
examples.note: necessary 触发虚拟，从句用原形 be，省略 should。

examples.en: It is necessary that he is told the truth.
examples.zh: 有必要让他知道真相。
examples.note: necessary 后的从句须用 (should) be done，不能用陈述语气的 is told。

examples.en: It is strange that she should have refused such a generous offer.
examples.zh: 她竟然拒绝了这么优厚的条件，真奇怪。
examples.note: strange 后保留 should，用 should have done 表示对已发生之事的意外。

examples.en: It is important that everyone follow the safety rules.
examples.zh: 每个人都遵守安全规则，这一点很重要。
examples.note: important 触发虚拟，从句用原形 follow，everyone 也不加 s。

examples.en: It is important that everyone follows the safety rules.
examples.zh: 每个人都遵守安全规则，这一点很重要。
examples.note: 虚拟从句谓语用原形，不能因为 everyone 是第三人称单数而加 s。

examples.en: It is essential that the data be checked twice.
examples.zh: 数据必须核对两遍。
examples.note: essential 触发虚拟，被动形式为 be checked。

examples.en: It is a pity that he should leave so soon.
examples.zh: 他这么快就要走，真遗憾。
examples.note: It is a pity that 属评价句型，从句用 should + 原形。

pitfalls.wrong: It is necessary that he goes there in person.
pitfalls.right: It is necessary that he go there in person.
pitfalls.why: necessary 后的从句用 (should) do，省略 should 后为原形，第三人称单数不加 s。

pitfalls.wrong: It is important that the letter is sent today.
pitfalls.right: It is important that the letter be sent today.
pitfalls.why: 被动语态的虚拟形式是 (should) be done，不能用陈述语气的 is sent。

pitfalls.wrong: It is strange that he refused such a good offer yesterday.
pitfalls.right: It is strange that he should have refused such a good offer yesterday.
pitfalls.why: 对已发生之事表示意外，须用 should have done；直接陈述则失去“竟然”的评价意味。

contrast.withTitle: 建议命令要求类动词后的 should 省略
contrast.diff: 两者从句形式相同，都是 (should) do；区别在触发位置：动词句型看主句动词，形容词句型看句首 It is + adj。

concept.mnemonic: 必要重要奇怪可惜，It is + adj + that 用原形；删掉 It is 和 that，剩下完整句就是强调句。

core: 句型：It is + necessary/important/strange/a pity + that + 主语 + (should) do
should 可省，省略后用原形，不加 s、不变时态
被动形式 (should) be done
陈述既成事实时用陈述语气：It is a fact that...
删减法区分强调句：去掉 It is 和 that 后能否独立成句
review.trigger: 看到 It is + 评价形容词 + that → 先删 It is 和 that 试读 → 读不通就上虚拟

quickCheck.q: It is vital that he ___ (stay) calm. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: stay，虚拟从句用原形。

quickCheck.q: It is important that the form ___ (sign) today. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: be signed，被动虚拟形式。

quickCheck.q: It is strange that he should have left 中 should 表示什么？
quickCheck.a: 表示“竟然”，对已发生之事感到意外。

drills.stem: It is necessary that every student ___ a copy of the handbook.
drills.answer: get
drills.explain: necessary 触发虚拟，从句用 (should) + 原形，省略 should 后为 get，every student 也不影响形式。
drills.trap: gets 按第三人称单数变化，但虚拟从句的谓语没有数和时态变化。

drills.stem: It is important that the report ___ (submit) before Friday.
drills.answer: be submitted
accept: be submitted
should be submitted
drills.hint: report 与 submit 是被动关系，先定语态再定虚拟形式。
drills.explain: important 后的从句用虚拟，被动语态为 (should) be done，省略 should 后是 be submitted。

drills.stem: It is strange that he refuses such a generous offer.
drills.answer: It is strange that he refuse such a generous offer.
accept: It is strange that he refuse such a generous offer.
It is strange that he should refuse such a generous offer.
drills.explain: strange 后的从句用 (should) do 表示“竟然”，省略 should 后为原形 refuse。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It is essential that the data be checked twice.
drills.explain: essential 触发虚拟，被动形式 be checked，data 作复数主语也不改变谓语形式。

drills.stem: 有必要让他知道真相。
drills.answer: It is necessary that he (should) be told the truth.
drills.explain: necessary 后接虚拟从句，he 与 tell 是被动关系，用 (should) be told。

drills.stem: It is a pity that she ___ so soon after joining the team.
drills.answer: should leave
drills.explain: It is a pity that 属评价句型，从句用 should + 原形表达“竟然、可惜”，这里保留 should 更自然。
drills.trap: leaves 是陈述语气，无法表达说话人对这件事的意外与惋惜。

items.title: as if / as though 的虚拟
items.brief: 像不像事实，决定用虚拟还是陈述

concept.summary: 判定标准：as if / as though 从句所述与事实不符或可能性极低时用虚拟——与现在相反用 did/were，与过去相反用 had done；若所述很可能是事实，则用陈述语气。判断依据是说话人对可能性的态度，从句形式不由主句时态决定。

sections.h: 两种语气，一条判据
sections.p: 同一个 as if 可以带两种从句，差别只在说话人是否认为所述为真。有可见证据支持时用陈述，纯属想象或明显相反时用虚拟。
bullets: 与现在事实相反：He talks as if he knew everything.（其实不懂）
与过去事实相反：She looked as if she had seen a ghost.
所述可能是事实：It looks as if it is going to rain.（乌云就在头顶）
系动词 look/seem/sound 后的 as if 从句最常考

sections.h: 主句时态不决定从句形式
sections.p: 从句形式由从句内容的时间决定。主句用过去式、从句用现在虚拟，是最常见的组合，不要因为主句是过去式就把从句也推到过去完成。
bullets: He spoke as if he were the manager.（现在虚拟 + 主句过去）
He speaks as if he had met her before.（过去虚拟 + 主句现在）
从句动作先于主句动作时，从句才用 had done

sections.h: 常见搭配与固定表达
sections.p: as if 前多是感官系动词或行为动词，两类搭配的语义不同：系动词后是“看起来像”，行为动词后是“表现得像”。
bullets: look / seem / sound / feel / appear + as if
treat / behave / act + as if（表现得好像）
as if to do：He raised his hand as if to say something.
It seems as if... 可能性高时用陈述语气

examples.en: He speaks English as if he were a native speaker.
examples.zh: 他说英语像母语者一样。
examples.note: 与现在事实相反，从句用 were。

examples.en: He talks as if he knows everything, but in fact he knows nothing.
examples.zh: 他说起话来好像什么都懂，其实什么都不懂。
examples.note: but in fact 已点明与事实相反，从句须用 knew，不能用陈述语气。

examples.en: She looked as if she had seen a ghost.
examples.zh: 她看上去像见了鬼一样。
examples.note: 从句动作先于主句 looked，用过去完成时表与过去事实相反。

examples.en: She looked as if she saw a ghost.
examples.zh: 她看上去像见了鬼一样。
examples.note: “见鬼”发生在“看上去”之前，须用 had seen 表示更早的过去。

examples.en: It looks as if it is going to rain.
examples.zh: 看起来要下雨了。
examples.note: 有可见迹象支持，所述很可能是事实，用陈述语气。

examples.en: The boy acted as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 那男孩表现得好像什么都没发生过。
examples.note: 与过去事实相反，从句用 had done。

examples.en: He ordered us about as if we were his servants.
examples.zh: 他到处支使我们，好像我们是他的佣人。
examples.note: 与现在事实相反，be 动词用 were。

pitfalls.wrong: He talks as if he is a doctor, but he has never studied medicine.
pitfalls.right: He talks as if he were a doctor, but he has never studied medicine.
pitfalls.why: 后半句已说明与现在事实相反，as if 从句须用 were，而不是陈述语气的 is。

pitfalls.wrong: She looked as if she saw a ghost.
pitfalls.right: She looked as if she had seen a ghost.
pitfalls.why: 从句动作发生在主句 looked 之前，须退到过去完成时 had seen。

pitfalls.wrong: It seems as if he were ill; he has a high fever.
pitfalls.right: It seems as if he is ill; he has a high fever.
pitfalls.why: 高烧是可见证据，说明所述很可能是事实，as if 从句用陈述语气。

contrast.diff: wish 后的从句必须虚拟；as if 后的从句可虚拟可陈述，取决于说话人认为所述是否可能为真。

concept.mnemonic: 明知不是用虚拟，眼见为实用陈述；现在 were，过去 had done。

core: as if / as though 从句：可能为真用陈述，明显相反用虚拟
与现在相反用 did/were，与过去相反用 had done
从句形式由从句时间决定，与主句时态无关
从句动作先于主句时用 had done
look/seem/sound/feel + as if 最常考
review.trigger: 看到 as if 从句 → 问“说话人认为这是真的吗” → 不是就退一步

quickCheck.q: He acts as if he ___ (be) the boss. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: were，与现在事实相反。

quickCheck.q: It looks as if it ___ (rain). 天已经阴了，填什么？
quickCheck.a: is going to rain，有证据用陈述语气。

quickCheck.q: as if 从句的动作先于主句，用什么形式？
quickCheck.a: 过去完成时 had done。

drills.stem: He speaks English as if he ___ a native speaker.
drills.answer: were
drills.explain: 说话人暗示他并不是母语者，与现在事实相反，as if 从句的 be 动词用 were。
drills.trap: is 是陈述语气，会使句子变成“他可能真是母语者”，与 as if 的虚拟意图不符。

drills.stem: She looked as if she ___ (see) a ghost.
drills.answer: had seen
accept: had seen
drills.explain: 从句动作先于主句 looked，与过去事实相反，用过去完成时 had seen。

drills.stem: The boy acted as if nothing happens.
drills.answer: The boy acted as if nothing had happened.
accept: The boy acted as if nothing had happened.
drills.explain: 主句 acted 指过去，从句所述与过去事实相反且先于主句，须用过去完成时 had happened。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It looks as if it is going to rain.
drills.explain: 天象有可见迹象，所述很可能是事实，as if 从句用陈述语气 is going to rain。

drills.stem: 他说起话来好像什么都知道。
drills.answer: He talks as if he knew everything.
drills.explain: 说话人暗示他并不全懂，与现在事实相反，as if 从句用一般过去时 knew。

drills.stem: It looks as if the train ___ late; the platform is still empty.
drills.answer: is
drills.explain: 站台空着是可见证据，说明列车晚点很可能是事实，as if 从句用陈述语气 is。
drills.trap: were 会把这句变成纯假设，与“站台仍然空着”这一观察证据冲突。

items.title: 含蓄条件句与 otherwise/but for
items.brief: 没有 if 从句，条件藏在介词或副词里

concept.summary: 判定标准：句中没有 if 从句，但由 but for、without、otherwise、or、but that 或分词短语暗示一个与事实相反的条件时，主句仍按虚拟公式取形式。时间由句中时间状语决定：指现在或将来用 would do，指过去用 would have done。

sections.h: 五类含蓄条件标记
sections.p: 这些标记的共同作用是把一个 if 从句压缩成短语或副词，所以主句必须保留虚拟形式，不能因为看不到 if 就改用陈述语气。
bullets: but for + 名词 = 要不是：But for your help, I would have failed.
without + 名词 = 没有：Without water, no plant would survive.
otherwise / or = 否则：I was busy then; otherwise I would have called.
but that + 从句 = 要不是：He would have come, but that he was ill.
分词短语：Given more time, we would have done better.

sections.h: otherwise 与 or 的时间由前一句定
sections.p: otherwise 承接前一句陈述的事实，前句用过去式，后面就用 would have done；前句用现在式，后面就用 would do。判断锚点始终在前一句的时态上。
bullets: I was ill that day; otherwise I would have attended the meeting.
I am busy now; otherwise I would help you with the report.
He must have been ill, or he would have come.
× I was busy yesterday; otherwise I would go with you.

sections.h: but for 与 without 的对应式
sections.p: but for 与 without 都可还原成 if 从句：指现在用 if it were not for，指过去用 if it had not been for。还原后按三步定式判断，就不会选错主句形式。
bullets: But for the storm, we would have arrived on time.（= If it had not been for the storm）
But for his support, the plan would fail.（= If it were not for his support）
Without your encouragement, I would have given up.
but for 后只接名词，不接从句；接从句用 but that

examples.en: But for the traffic jam, we would have caught the flight.
examples.zh: 要不是堵车，我们就赶上航班了。
examples.note: but for 暗示过去相反的条件，主句用 would have done。

examples.en: But for the traffic jam, we would catch the flight.
examples.zh: 要不是堵车，我们就赶上航班了。
examples.note: 航班是过去的事，主句须用 would have caught，不能用 would catch。

examples.en: Without your encouragement, I would have given up.
examples.zh: 没有你的鼓励，我早就放弃了。
examples.note: without 隐含过去相反条件，主句用 would have done。

examples.en: I was tired that night; otherwise I would go to the concert.
examples.zh: 那晚我很累，否则我就去听音乐会了。
examples.note: 前句 was 锁定过去，otherwise 后用 would have gone。

examples.en: But for that mistake, he would be a rich man today.
examples.zh: 要不是那个错误，他今天就是个富翁了。
examples.note: today 说明主句指现在，用 would be。

examples.en: Given more time, we could have finished the report.
examples.zh: 多给些时间，我们本可以完成报告。
examples.note: 过去分词短语 Given more time 暗示与过去相反的条件。

examples.en: She must have been ill, or she would have come.
examples.zh: 她一定是病了，否则她就来了。
examples.note: or 承接前句的过去推测，后面用 would have come。

pitfalls.wrong: But for your help, I would fail the exam last term.
pitfalls.right: But for your help, I would have failed the exam last term.
pitfalls.why: last term 锁定过去，含蓄条件句的主句同样要用 would have done。

pitfalls.wrong: I was busy yesterday; otherwise I would go to see you.
pitfalls.right: I was busy yesterday; otherwise I would have gone to see you.
pitfalls.why: otherwise 的时间由前句 was 决定，前句指过去则主句用 would have done。

pitfalls.wrong: Without your help, I would not finish the work yesterday.
pitfalls.right: Without your help, I would not have finished the work yesterday.
pitfalls.why: without 只是把 if 从句压缩成短语，时间仍由 yesterday 锁定在过去。

contrast.withTitle: 省略 if 的倒装虚拟
contrast.diff: 倒装虚拟保留完整从句，只删 if 并前置助动词；含蓄条件句没有从句，条件被压缩进 but for、without、otherwise 等短语。

concept.mnemonic: but for 要不是，without 没有，otherwise 否则；看不到 if 也要用 would。

core: 五类标记：but for、without、otherwise/or、but that、分词短语
标记只压缩条件，主句仍按虚拟公式取形式
指现在用 would do，指过去用 would have done
otherwise 的时间由前一句时态决定
but for = if it were not for / if it had not been for
review.trigger: 看到 but for / without / otherwise → 先还原成 if 从句 → 再判时间选主句形式

quickCheck.q: But for the rain, we ___ (arrive) earlier yesterday. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: would have arrived。

quickCheck.q: otherwise 前句是 was，后面用什么？
quickCheck.a: would have done。

quickCheck.q: but for 后面能接从句吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，只能接名词；接从句用 but that。

drills.stem: But for your timely warning, we ___ into the trap.
drills.answer: would have fallen
drills.explain: but for 暗示一个与过去事实相反的条件，主句用 would have done，表示“本来会掉进去”。
drills.trap: would fall 指现在或将来，与 but for 所承接的已发生情形不符。

drills.stem: I was tied up yesterday; otherwise I ___ (come) to your party.
drills.answer: would have come
accept: would have come
drills.hint: otherwise 的时间看前一句的时态。
drills.explain: 前句 was 指过去，otherwise 后表示与过去相反的假设，用 would have come。

drills.stem: Without your help, I would not finish the work last week.
drills.answer: Without your help, I would not have finished the work last week.
accept: Without your help, I would not have finished the work last week.
drills.explain: last week 锁定过去，without 隐含的过去相反条件要求主句用 would not have finished。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Given more time, we could have done better.
drills.explain: 过去分词短语 Given more time 相当于 If we had been given more time，主句用 could have done。

drills.stem: 要不是那场雨，比赛本会照常进行。
drills.answer: But for the rain, the match would have gone ahead as planned.
drills.explain: but for 后接名词表示与过去相反的条件，主句用 would have gone ahead。

drills.stem: I am busy with the report now; otherwise I ___ you with the survey.
drills.answer: would help
drills.explain: 前句 am busy 与 now 说明是现在的情形，otherwise 后表示与现在相反的假设，用 would help。
drills.trap: would have helped 指过去，与 now 和前句的现在时冲突。
